page: Amazon Web Services m7gd.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an AWS Graviton Neoverse-V1 ARMv8 processor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores running at 2.6 GHz with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and includes 474 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage. Network performance is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth, running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate average performance across most standard workloads. The instance achieves average scores in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, as well as in stress-ng CPU evaluations. Memory performance is a notable highlight, with the Passmark memory score ranking in the top 25%, supported by a cached read-only memory bandwidth of 775.64 GB/sec. However, decompression tasks show some limitations, with bzip3 single-threaded decompression scoring in the bottom 10%. Cryptography and encryption tests also register in the bottom 25%.

The arm64 architecture and dedicated core allocation offer a balanced resource profile, making this instance a cost-efficient choice for workloads requiring local NVMe storage without the overhead of x86 architectures. It is well-suited for general-purpose applications, database operations, static web serving, and software compilation. The presence of local NVMe SSD storage makes it particularly effective for caching layers, intermediate data processing, and localized database deployments.
